in_sanskrit.name: Majibul
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Majestic, Powerful
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Majibul एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Majibul is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'majja' meaning majesty and 'bul' meaning powerful. This name evokes a sense of strength, wisdom and knowledge. It is a name for a boy who is expected to grow up to be a powerful and majestic leader.
